title: Amazon EventBridge to AWS Step Functions to AWS Lambda
description: Create an EventBridge rule that triggers a Step Functions workflow that uses Lambda.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The Terraform template deploys a AWS Step Function, a AWS Lambda function, a CloudWatch Event Rule and the minimum IAM resources required to run the application.
This pattern demonstrates the use of Terraform modules and configures a CloudWatch Event rule to start execution of a AWS Step Functionswhich in turn invokes a AWS Lambda
